rules.title: Los Angeles RSO annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: Rent for units covered by the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance may be raised only by the annual allowable percentage, which was 3% for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. Landlords may also pass through registered RSO ($1.61/month) and SCEP ($2.83/month) fee surcharges with proper written notice.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); tenants can check RSO status via ZIMAS. The page does not state the building-age or other coverage criteria.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Unit must be subject to the RSO (status determined via ZIMAS lookup); the page does not state the RSO coverage criteria.

rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
rules.conflict_note: The page, retrieved 2026-10-01, still shows the 3% figure for July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026, a period that ended before the query date. The allowable percentage for July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027 is not stated and may differ. No official code citation is given on the page.

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO: no additional utility percentage increase
rules.requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords of RSO units may not add any extra percentage increase for utilities on top of the annual allowable rent increase.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
